title: Original course previews in multiplayer lobby portrait
summary: The multiplayer lobby course preview remains readable in the host portrait layout while the selected Sausalito name and artwork are synchronized across both clients.
details: The same final host-browser gate passed all 40 map choices, with 39 original source preview pairs and an authored Training fallback. Both clients' names and artwork synchronized; viewport bounds passed across five sizes and three multiplayer roles.
The inspected 390×844 portrait capture shows the lobby, Sausalito course preview, player count and invite controls without clipped content. It is automated Chromium, not a physical phone.
limitation: Host-only verification; this is the course-preview/UI checkpoint and does not establish full multiplayer or whole-game equivalence.
